title: processkit document front matter
description: Front matter keys processkit reads from a Markdown file matched by a document source (PK-DOC-004). Front matter is optional. Other keys are kept and ignored, so files written for other tools stay valid. Identity, namespace, and labels come from the document source (document-sources.schema.json).

name.description: Document name; default: the file name without .md.

title.description: Default: the text of the first level-1 heading, else the name.

summary.description: Replaces the document source's summary for this file.

triggers.description: Replaces the document source's triggers for this file.
